description: Linux is an operating system used on many computers and servers. A shell reads typed commands. We will practise safe commands in a folder made only for these lessons. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain create and enter a folder
Explain write and read a small file

seo.title: Linux Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Linux with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
